text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, fludarabine phosphate is not on the FDA shortage list. Corvale East holds 15 vials of the 50 mg/2 mL presentation (4.4 days) and 18 vials of the 25 mg/mL presentation (4.1 days). Corvale General holds 82 vials of 50 mg/2 mL (18.2 days) and 53 vials of 25 mg/mL (12.2 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 6 vials of 50 mg/2 mL (6.3 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the prior shortage was first posted 2022-05-06 and is now resolved; the drug is not listed as in shortage as of 2026-10-21. A separate label for Areva Pharmaceuticals names NerPharMa SRL (FEI 3004762406) as a registered manufacturing plant with a VAI inspection ending 2024-09-13; the most recent classification letter is dated 2024-12-12. No FDA regulatory action dated before the 2022-05-06 shortage posting is recorded for the ACTAVIS TOTOWA plant that supplies our NDC.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is below target for both presentations. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support an internal transfer without dropping below two weeks of supply. No active FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 18 vials of fludarabine phosphate 50 mg/2 mL, 2 mL vial from Corvale General to Corvale East — raises Corvale East to approximately 10 days while Corvale General retains approximately 14 days. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Evaluate purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — not on FDA shortage list; plant last inspected VAI 2023-08-24. Approval: Buyer.
3. Evaluate purchase from Hisun Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. — not on FDA shortage list; label names no identifiable plant. Approval: Buyer.
4. Evaluate purchase from Lannett Company, Inc. — not on FDA shortage list; label names no identifiable plant. Approval: Buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Sagent Pharmaceuticals — not on FDA shortage list; label names no identifiable plant. Approval: Buyer.

Not recommended: No external allocation requests or emergency purchases at this time; internal transfer resolves the immediate gap.
